title: Engine-Hours and Service Interval
dataSources: NMEA/SignalK data (`nmea:reading`), bilge pump (`bilge:event`), mooring/anchor watch (`mooring:status`), marine weather (`marineweather:forecast`).
app: Marine electronics — NMEA 2000 / SignalK boat networks, bilge, battery and shore-power sensors, anchor-watch GPS, and marine weather feeds — streamed to Splunk HEC via SignalK and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=nmea:reading measurement=engine
| stats max(engine_hours) as hours, latest(hours_at_service) as serviced by engine
| eval since=hours-serviced, due=if(since>100,1,0)
description: Tracks engine hours since the last service and reminds you when an oil change or impeller check is due.
value: Marine engines are serviced by the hour; missing an interval risks an expensive failure far from a mechanic.
implementation: Ingest engine-hour telemetry into `index=personal`; alert when hours since service pass the interval.
visualization: Single-value tile of engine hours since service.
grandmaExplanation: It tracks the boat engine's running hours and reminds you when it needs its next service.
